title: Mbewu leyitsongo
description: Eka tikoxikaya ra le tlhelo ka Mount Kenya, nhwana lontsongo a tirha emansin’wini na manana wa yena. A vilerisiwa hi loko a vona swihlahla leswikulu swi nyamalala, kambe a tiva matimba ya mbewu letyintsongo.
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
